Major

1.  Suxamethonium Apnoea - deficient metabolism secondary to abnormal butylcholinesterase production
2.  Anaphylaxis - IgE Medicated allergy 
3.  Malignant Hyperthermia - Ryanodine receptor mutations →  uncontrolled excitation contraction coupling

Minor

1.  Arrhythmia & Bradycardia - Arrhythmia due to SA node stimulation,  Bradycardia due to agonism at M2 ACh receptors particularly with large or repeat doses 
2.  Muscle pains - secondary to fasciculations 
3.  Hyperkalaemia - depolarisation → K+ efflux, effect ↑ in burns due to extra junction receptors 

Pressures

1.  ↑ Intraocular pressure - secondary to fasciculations
2.  ↑ intracranial pressure - secondary to fasciculations and 
3.  ↑ gastric pressure - secondary to fasciculations/muscle contraction
